title: Berenschot offers framework and referral value only, not build capability
content:
Berenschot is vendor-neutral and has no build capability, so the value in the relationship is framework and referral only. It can shape how a Dutch buyer frames a problem and it can make introductions; it cannot implement anything.

That is worth stating plainly because advisory firms are easy to over-rate in a lead list: they turn up near every interesting decision without ever being the party that acts. The realistic ask of Berenschot is that its frameworks and its introductions point somewhere useful. Priority 4 reflects that — it stays in the set as a referral route rather than as a delivery candidate.
